description: Returns current aviation color codes (VONA) and volcanic alert levels (VALS) for Icelandic volcanic systems from Veðurstofa Íslands (api.vedur.is/volcanoes), sorted with elevated unrest first (max 20).

active_only.description: Only return systems with elevated VONA aviation color or VALS level > 0 (default false).

limit.description: Maximum volcano entries to return (1-20, default 20).

volcano.description: Optional volcano name or 3-letter code filter (e.g. REY, Reykjanes, Askja, Katla, Hekla, Grímsvötn).

name: get_volcano_status
title: Get Icelandic Volcano Status (VONA & VALS)
